definitions.explanation: A general term for animals that have shells, including clams, oysters, snails, and other mollusks. Used both in everyday contexts (cooking, seafood) and scientific contexts (biology).

examples.japanese: {貝類|かいるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な{貝類|かいるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: You can get fresh shellfish at this market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{干潟|ひがた}→干潟：05592_higata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{貝類|かいるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧になっている。
examples.english: Various shellfish live in the tidal flats, making it a popular spot for clam digging.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{貝|かい}→貝：02145_kai⟧ (shell, shellfish) + ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (kind, category). This is the general category term for all shell-bearing mollusks. In cooking and food contexts, it typically refers to edible shellfish like clams, oysters, and mussels.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貝類|かいるい}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: shellfish allergy
- {貝類|かいるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{採取|さいしゅ}→採取：12901_saishu⟧: shellfish harvesting
- ⟦{二枚貝|にまいがい}→二枚貝：23394_nimaigai⟧⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧: bivalves (clams, oysters, mussels)
- {巻|まき}{貝類|かいるい}: gastropods (snails, whelks)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貝|かい}→貝：02145_kai⟧: shell; shellfish — the basic word, can refer to both the animal and the shell
- ⟦{甲殻類|こうかくるい}→甲殻類：20910_koukakurui⟧: crustaceans — crabs, shrimp, lobsters (different from shellfish)
- ⟦{魚介類|ぎょかいるい}→魚介類：23435_gyokairui⟧: seafood — the broader category including fish and shellfish
